title: Arquiteto De Software
description: A VMetrix é uma empresa SaaS que desenvolve uma plataforma financeira integral utilizada por bancos, fundos de pensão, gestoras de fundos, corretoras e asset managers no Chile e na América Latina. Nossa plataforma cobre o ciclo completo de gestão de investimentos: desde a captura de operações e gestão do ciclo de vida transacional, até a precificação, contabilidade, risco de mercado, compliance regulatório e reporting. Propósito do Cargo Arquiteto de Software é responsável por definir, evoluir e governar a arquitetura técnica da plataforma VMetrix. Este papel atua como ponte entre os requisitos de negócio financeiro, as restrições regulatórias e a implementação técnica, garantindo que as decisões arquiteturais suportem a escalabilidade, manutenibilidade e compliance da plataforma a longo prazo. Lidera o design dos sistemas mais complexos, estabelece os padrões técnicos para toda a equipe de desenvolvimento e governa a adoção estratégica de ferramentas de IA no ciclo de engenharia. Responsabilidades Principais: Desenvolvimento e Manutenção da Plataforma Desenvolver e manter módulos core da plataforma: ciclo de vida transacional (captura, validação, aprovação, liquidação), precificação de instrumentos, contabilidade de investimentos, risco de mercado e reporting regulatório. Implementar lógica de negócio financeiro complexa: processos de precificação mark-to-market, cálculos de P&L, accruals, amortizações, simulações end-of-day e processos batch de fechamento. Escrever código bem estruturado, eficiente, testável e aderente aos padrões arquiteturais definidos pela equipe de Arquitetura. Identificar bugs, gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria na base de código, propondo e implementando soluções com foco em qualidade e manutenibilidade. Antecipar necessidades futuras do sistema, sendo proativo na identificação de riscos técnicos e propondo soluções antes que se tornem impedimentos. Arquitetura de Dados e PL/SQL Projetar e otimizar procedures PL/SQL em Oracle 21c, incluindo pipelined functions, estratégias com Global Temporary Tables e packages de cálculo financeiro. Construir APIs REST robustas para integração com sistemas externos (ERPs, sistemas contábeis, provedores de dados de mercado), cobrindo múltiplas classes de ativos. Participar no design de motores genéricos com arquitetura metadata-driven, múltiplas estratégias de execução e cache de alto desempenho. Qualidade, Testes e Revisão de Código Analisar, depurar e testar software de forma sistemática, garantindo conformidade com as especificações técnicas definidas. Realizar revisões de código com foco em qualidade, segurança, performance e aderência aos padrões arquiteturais da plataforma. Definir e aplicar estratégias de testes (unitários, integração, contrato) em colaboração com o time de Arquitetura. Garantir que os módulos desenvolvidos sejam seguros, estáveis e aderentes às exigências regulatórias dos mercados atendidos. Colaboração Técnica e Mentoria Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com o Arquiteto de Software e Tech Leads para o cumprimento das diretrizes técnicas e das demandas da área. Realizar mentoria técnica de desenvolvedores juniores e plenos: revisões de design, pair programming e transferência de conhecimento do domínio financeiro. Participar ativamente de reuniões técnicas de equipe para discussão e alinhamento de demandas, soluções e prioridades. Monitorar tendências e tecnologias, contribuindo com propostas de melhoria de processos e ferramentas utilizadas no desenvolvimento dos produtos da empresa. Desenvolvimento Assistido por IA Utilizar ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) de forma produtiva e responsável no ciclo diário de desenvolvimento: geração de código, revisão, debugging e escrita de testes. Elaborar e consumir especificações técnicas otimizadas para uso com LLMs, garantindo que a documentação sirva tanto para a equipe quanto como contexto de alta qualidade para ferramentas de IA generativa. Aplicar engenharia de prompts no contexto de desenvolvimento: formular contextos precisos, decompor problemas e validar criticamente as saídas de modelos de linguagem. Requisitos Técnicos: Formação acadêmica: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação ou certificações técnicas relevantes são diferenciais. 5+ anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento de software. Domínio avançado de Java 8+ e Spring Boot 2.7+ (injeção de dependências, REST controllers, transações, testes). Experiência sólida em Oracle Database (PL/SQL, pipelined functions, partitioning, performance tuning, schemas complexos). Conhecimento prático de Kubernetes (OKE) e deployments em containers (Docker, WebLogic em OKE). Experiência com padrões de arquitetura: metadata-driven designs, cache distribuído (Caffeine/Redis), event-driven, repository pattern. Familiaridade com ferramentas de desenvolvimento modernas: Git e Git Flow, pipelines CI/CD, Postman/OpenAPI. Experiência prática com ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA: Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot ou similares — incluindo uso em geração de código, escrita de testes, refatoração e debugging. Capacidade de engenharia de prompts aplicada ao desenvolvimento: saber formular contextos precisos, decompor problemas e validar criticamente as saídas de modelos de linguagem. Capacidade de ler e produzir especificações técnicas detalhadas em formato Markdown. Requisitos Desejáveis: Conhecimento do domínio financeiro: renda fixa, renda variável, derivativos, fundos de investimento, gestão de portfólios, contabilidade de investimentos, risco de mercado. Experiência com regulação financeira brasileira ou latino-americana (CVM, BACEN, ANBIMA, ou órgãos equivalentes). Experiência com integrações Office (Excel Add-ins) para plataformas SaaS financeiras. Familiaridade com padrões da indústria financeira (FpML, ISDA, ou outros). Experiência com observabilidade: Grafana, métricas de aplicação, alerting. Conhecimento de práticas GitOps e versionamento de infraestrutura como código (IaC). Familiaridade com testes de contrato (contract testing) e testes de integração em arquiteturas de microsserviços. Certificação Java (OCA/OCP) ou certificações equivalentes em tecnologias do stack. Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas de tecnologia, engenharia ou gestão de inovação. Processo de Candidatura: Candidatura: Candidate-se diretamente pelo LinkedIn. Teste técnico: Os candidatos selecionados receberão uma avaliação técnica online. Esta etapa é obrigatória e parte fundamental do processo. Entrevista com Líder e RH: Uma conversa com a equipe para te conhecer melhor e aprofundar sua experiência. Decisão: Informaremos o resultado com feedback, independentemente de você avançar ou não. Por que trabalhar na VMetrix Na VMetrix, não buscamos “fazer mais barulho”, mas sim construir confiança em um mercado onde as decisões importam. Você terá a oportunidade de liderar uma função estratégica, com autonomia real, impacto direto no negócio e visibilidade executiva. Você fará parte de uma empresa que está redefinindo como as instituições financeiras adotam tecnologia crítica, em um ambiente desafiador, sofisticado e de alto nível profissional. Se você se motiva a construir marca, reputação e relações de longo prazo no coração do sistema financeiro, a VMetrix é o lugar.

title: Especialista De Arquitetura E Implantação | Expansão
description: Descrição da vaga No Azzas 2154 Fashion & Lifestyle, somos movidos por pessoas. São elas que impulsionam ideias, constroem marcas e fazem a moda acontecer todos os dias. Aqui, cada pessoa tem voz, espaço e responsabilidade na construção do que fazemos. É assim, todos os dias, que nos tornamos o maior Grupo de Moda da América Latina. Buscamos um perfil estratégico e multidisciplinar para atuar no coração da expansão do Grupo F&L. Você será responsável por gerenciar a arquitetura e a implantação de lojas para diversas marcas do portfólio, garantindo que cada conceito criativo seja traduzido em espaços viáveis, rentáveis e escaláveis. É uma posição de alta visibilidade, que exige trânsito entre o criativo e o financeiro, com foco em excelência operacional. Responsabilidades e atribuições Desenvolvimento de Conceito Multimarca: Colaborar com os times criativos de cada marca (Reserva, Sprint, Oficina, etc.) para refinar conceitos arquitetônicos, garantindo que a execução seja fiel ao DNA de cada marca e economicamente viável. Engenharia de Valor e Escalabilidade: Analisar criticamente os projetos para garantir que as soluções sejam escaláveis (rollout), definindo padrões técnicos que otimizem prazos e custos sem comprometer a estética. Gestão de Implantação e Obras: Liderar o ciclo completo de obras e reformas de todo o portfólio do grupo, do planejamento inicial à entrega das chaves. Interface Estratégica com Administradoras: Atuar como interlocutor técnico sênior junto aos grandes players de shopping ( Multiplan, Allos, Ancar, etc. ), negociando cadernos técnicos e prazos de aprovação. Gestão de CAPEX e Parceiros: Equalizar orçamentos, realizar a precificação junto a parceiros estratégicos e garantir que cada inauguração respeite as metas financeiras do Grupo. Homologação e Fiscalização: Selecionar e gerenciar fornecedores e empreiteiras, realizando visitas técnicas para garantir a qualidade de entrega e o cumprimento dos cronogramas. Legalização: Coordenar os processos de obtenção de alvarás e licenças, garantindo a conformidade de todas as unidades do grupo. Requisitos e qualificações Formação: Superior completo em Arquitetura e Urbanismo (preferencial) ou Engenharia Civil. Experiência: Sólida bagagem em implantação de varejo, preferencialmente com experiência em gestão de múltiplas marcas simultâneas. Bagagem de Mercado: Experiência em marcas que são referências em conceito e experiência de loja ou em grandes administradoras de shoppings é um diferencial importante. Soft Skills Inegociáveis: * Comunicação e Articulação: Habilidade para escrever e falar com clareza, influenciando parceiros externos e reportando resultados para a liderança. Autonomia e Proatividade: Perfil "dono do negócio", capaz de gerir múltiplos cronogramas e tomar decisões rápidas em cenários de obra. Organização: Disciplina para gerenciar orçamentos e prazos de diferentes marcas ao mesmo tempo. Ferramentas: Domínio de AutoCad e Pacote Office (Excel avançado para controle de CAPEX). Mobilidade: Residir no Rio de Janeiro e ter disponibilidade para viagens. Informações adicionais NOSSOS BENEFÍCIOS No Azzas 2154 Fashion & Lifestyle, acreditamos que cuidar das pessoas é parte essencial para construir o maior Grupo de Moda da América Latina. Por isso, oferecemos um conjunto de benefícios pensado para apoiar o bem-estar, o desenvolvimento e o dia a dia de quem faz parte da nossa história. Saúde e bem estar - Plano de saúde - Plano odontológico - Seguro de vida - Programas de bem-estar físico, como Wellhub ou TotalPass - Iniciativas de apoio à saúde mental Dia a dia e qualidade de vida - Benefícios flexíveis por meio de cartão Flash - Vale transporte - Day off de aniversário - Extensão de licença maternidade - Extensão de licença paternidade - Descontos nas marcas do grupo Desenvolvimento e crescimento - Programas de capacitação e desenvolvimento - Trilhas de aprendizagem corporativas - Iniciativas de reconhecimento e engajamento Reconhecimento - Participação nos resultados, conforme política vigente * Os benefícios podem variar de acordo com o cargo, a unidade e as políticas internas da companhia.

title: Data Operations Analyst
description: About Us: YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence. We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery. What It’s Like to Work at YipitData: YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers. Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData: Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for. About The Role: The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs. Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale. As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will: Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics. Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs. Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time. Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale. Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows. Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy. Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances. Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability. Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data. You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have… 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality. Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments. Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on. The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data. High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis. Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills. The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability. Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders. Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher). Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required): Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms. Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows. Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus. What We Offer: Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings. Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Personal laptop Health and wellness package Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132
description:
About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L Job Overview: An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers, and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end. Key Responsibilities: Team Leadership Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation. Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads. Technical Oversight Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading, Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues. Problem Design (Individual Contribution) Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain. Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions. Electrical Engineering Subdomains: You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus: Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation. Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization. RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design. Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design. Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting. Required Qualifications: Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline. At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation. At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role. Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows. Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments. Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs. Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.G., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar). Nice-to-Have: Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks. Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation. Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems. Evaluation Process: Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form. After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round. Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements. After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile. Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.Com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Technical Product Owner
description: ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data. Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively. THE ROLE We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance. What You’ll Do Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage. WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams. Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment. Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process. WHAT WE OFFER Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all. Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued. OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Conversion Rate Optimization Manager
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken) Please upload your CV Resume in English. Monthly salary: $2,000 - $2,200 USD Along with our partner, we are seeking a Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Manager who will drive revenue growth by optimizing conversion rates, improving user experience, and reducing friction across the customer journey on their Shopify storefront. You will oversee and execute A/B testing, user behavior analyses, funnel audits, and UX gap analyses. You will have the knowledge and experience to use CRO reports, experiment results, and dashboards to identify areas for optimization and will lead projects to implement those findings. You will conduct competitive research and deploy the latest developments in conversion rate optimization in partnership with their development and ecommerce teams. Essential Functions A/B Testing and Experimentation: Design, execute, and analyze A/B and multivariate tests across key pages and touchpoints. Prioritize experiments based on potential impact, traffic, and business goals to build a rigorous, data-driven testing roadmap. On-Site Optimization: Optimize landing pages, product detail pages (PDPs), collection pages, cart, and checkout flows to maximize conversion. Collaborate with their ecommerce and design teams to ensure all pages are aligned with CRO best practices. User Behavior Analysis: Leverage heatmaps, session recordings, funnel analytics, and user surveys to uncover friction points and opportunities. Translate qualitative and quantitative insights into actionable hypotheses. Shopify & Development Collaboration: Partner closely with their development team to implement CRO changes on the Shopify platform. Ensure experiments and site updates are implemented accurately, QA tested, and deployed efficiently. Funnel & Revenue Optimization: Identify and prioritize drop-off points across the customer journey from acquisition through post-purchase and develop initiatives to reduce abandonment, increase AOV, and improve repeat purchase rates. Reporting and Analysis: Provide regular reports on CRO performance, experiment results, and KPIs using analytics and CRO tools. Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to stakeholders and leadership. Other duties may be assigned What you will bring / Qualifications To perform this job successfully, you must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. In-depth knowledge of CRO principles, UX best practices, and e-commerce conversion frameworks. Strong understanding of A/B testing methodology, statistical significance, and experiment design. Hands-on experience with Shopify or a comparable e-commerce platform;
ability to collaborateeffectively with development teams on implementation. Proficiency in using CRO and analytics tools such as Google Analytics, heatmap tools, and experimentation platforms. Ability to read, analyze, and interpret complex data sets, experiment results, and performance reports. Ability to present findings and recommendations to cross-functional teams and leadership. Ability to solve practical problems and apply structured experimentation methodology in ambiguous situations. Ability to interpret quantitative and qualitative data to form clear, testable hypotheses. Ability to calculate and interpret key metrics such as conversion rates, statistical significance, and revenue metrics. Education and/or experience Bachelor’s degree from a four-year college or university, or equivalent experience as a CRO specialist or analyst in e-commerce. 3–5 years of experience managing a CRO program or cross-functional optimization team. Core competencies Action Oriented: Taking on new opportunities and challenges with urgency and energy. Resourcefulness: Securing and deploying resources effectively. Collaboration: Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others. Self-Development: Actively seeking growth opportunities. Strategic Thinking: Identifying opportunities and adapting to trends. Technical Proficiency & Problem Solving: Using tools and data to drive solutions. Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills. Results-driven: Focused on measurable, data-driven outcomes. Benefits A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance. The opportunity to drive measurable revenue growth by optimizing user experience and conversion performance. Two weeks of paid vacation per year. 10 paid days for local holidays. *Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Institutional Relations Manager
description:
Founded in 1948, Karadeniz Holding is a visionary industry leader that focuses on innovation while supporting growth with an emphasis on economic and environmental sustainability across a wide range of industries, primarily energy and shipbuilding. Operating in more than 20 countries, with over 3,000 employees from 30 different nationalities and an installed capacity exceeding 8,000 MW, the Group generates reliable and clean electricity across four continents through its fleet of 45 PowershipsTM and 11 LNG vessels, providing employment to more than 10,000 people worldwide. Karadeniz Holding manages its PowershipTM fleet under its international brand Karpowership, meeting between 10% and 100% of the electricity needs of the countries where it operates across Europe, Africa, the Americas, and Asia. With high-capacity energy solutions, including PowershipTM, land-based plants, and floating LNG infrastructure, Karpowership supports countries and companies in their energy transition processes. We are looking for an Institutional Relations Manager to join our operations in Brazil, based at our Rio de Janeiro office. WHAT DO WE EXPECT? - Bachelor's degree in Law, Economics, Engineering, Business Administration or related fields;
postgraduate degree orMBA will be considered a plus, - Minimum of 8 years of experience in institutional, governmental, or regulatory affairs, preferably within the energy sector (power generation, natural gas, oil & gas, or infrastructure), - Strong knowledge of the Brazilian regulatory environment, especially in the electricity and natural gas sectors, including interaction with entities such as ANEEL, ONS, and MME, - Proven experience in managing relationships with key stakeholders (government, regulators, associations, and institutional partners), - Advanced English (spoken and written), - Strong communication, negotiation, and influencing skills in complex and multicultural environments, - Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret regulatory scenarios and anticipate risks and opportunities, - Leadership skills, project management capabilities, and ability to work cross-functionally, - Ability to work under pressure, manage multiple priorities, and handle strategic topics, - High ethical standards and alignment with compliance and corporate governance practices, - Proactive profile with autonomy and ability to develop strategic and innovative solutions. WHAT AWAITS YOU? - Lead and execute KPS Brazil's institutional and governmental relations strategy, ensuring alignment with business and regulatory objectives, - Develop and maintain strategic relationships with government bodies, regulators, and industry entities, including ANEEL, ONS, MME, IBAMA, and other relevant stakeholders, - Continuously monitor and analyze the regulatory and institutional landscape of the electricity and natural gas sectors in Brazil, anticipating risks and opportunities, - Proactively represent and defend the company's interests in public consultations, hearings, and regulatory forums, - Coordinate licensing processes, authorizations, and institutional interactions required for project implementation, operation, and continuity (including Powerships and onshore assets), - Structure and implement stakeholder engagement strategies at local, regional, and national levels, including governments, communities, and strategic partners, - Support institutional and contractual negotiations with public authorities and regulatory bodies, ensuring legal compliance and risk mitigation, - Work closely with legal, regulatory, commercial, and operational teams to ensure consistency in the company's institutional positioning, - Manage institutional crises and sensitive matters, ensuring effective communication and strategic positioning, - Lead the preparation of strategic reports and executive analyses on the regulatory and institutional environment to support senior leadership decision-making, - Represent the company in industry associations, chambers of commerce, and energy sector forums, strengthening KPS's institutional presence in Brazil, - Ensure compliance with corporate governance, ethics, and compliance guidelines in all institutional interactions. WHAT DO WE OFFER? - Hybrid working model, - One day off on your birthday, - Private health insurance (extended to dependents) and life insurance, - Variable compensation package and performance-based bonus, - Meal allowance + food allowance in line with market practices, - Mobility benefits (transport allowance and parking policy), - Well-being and quality of life programs, including TotalPass, - Professional and personal training and development opportunities, - Multicultural environment with exposure to international projects, - Opportunity to contribute to strategic energy transition projects. In line with our "One World" philosophy, we are adding success to our achievements with our colleagues, candidates, and all stakeholders. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all applicants, regardless of race, religion, language or gender and we crown our success with our diversity. In accordance with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law – LGPD (Law No. 13,709/2018), we kindly ask you to review our Privacy Notice for detailed information regarding the processing of your personal data.

title: Operations Director
description: Kinetic Homes - Operations Director Introduction: Kinetic Homes is a homebuilder based in Jacksonville FL focused on expanding homeownership by constructing high quality, affordable homes in vibrant neighborhoods. The business was founded by Erik Nordahl and has built & sold over 100 homes over the past 3 years. This role will be an early hire in a rapidly growing organization. Mentorship and professional development are critical to Erik, and he will seek to assist his colleagues in their professional development and share the learnings he has accumulated throughout his career. This individual will have opportunity to eventually manage a team of individual contributors in the future. Compensation: $40,000-90,000 USD per year. Duties & Responsibilities: Permitting Ensure all necessary permits are obtained for new construction projects. Complete and submit permit applications for new construction. Assist with septic permits and HOA applications. Address permit application rejections in a timely manner. Facilitate communication between surveyors, architects, engineers, etc. via email and phone. Assist team in due diligence process coordination for all transactions. Maintain closing calendars for transactions to ensure team is aware of key deadlines and terms. title: Ai Quality Analyst (Portuguese)
description: Company Description MillionLogics, a trusted Oracle Partner, is a global IT solutions provider with offices in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. The company specialises in delivering smart, scalable, and future-ready IT solutions to empower businesses to evolve and lead. With expertise in Data & AI, Cloud migrations, IT consulting, and enterprise application optimisation, MillionLogics offers tailored services with a focus on client success. Supported by a team of over 50 AI & Oracle experts, MillionLogics combines cutting-edge technology with a commitment to delivering impactful outcomes. Learn more about our services on our website. Role Overview: As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalisation feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigour. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalised responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness. Offer Details: Pay: US$ 1500 per month (Net/take-home) Contract Duration: 12 months Number of Open Positions: 20 Key Qualifications Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portuguese with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project. Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team. Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalisation quality. Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities. Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalisation concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalisation, poor inferences, and forced connections. Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating. Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers. Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection. Description: In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalised AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve: Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilise your personal information and experiences. Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalisation was appropriately applied. Analysing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations. Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic\ "overnarrating\". Rigorouslyevaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable. Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation. Extracting and verifying\ "Debug Info\" from the modelto confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilised. Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history. Education & Experience BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.G., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field). Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred. Offer Details: Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and a minimum of 30 hours per week, with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week) Engagement type: Contractor Evaluation Process - Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements. How to Apply? Please send us your updated CV to with job ID: 62131 as your email subject.

title: Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer

Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients. Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes. Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc. Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team. Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues. Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise. Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction. Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery. The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities. Education Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree. Knowledge & Skills This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts. Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset. Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues. Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment. Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters. Excellent public speaking and presentation skills. Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software. Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset. Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English. Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil. Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers. Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English. - Threat Intel: Conhecimento em plataformas de TI (MISP, OpenCTI) e consumo de feeds de inteligência;
- VulnerabilityManagement: Operação de ferramentas como Tenable.

Deliver complete problem sets including reference solutions, near-miss variants, edge cases, and documentation, ensure appropriate difficulty with multiple failure modes, and collaborate with researchers to refine problems based on model performance. expertise spanning multiple tracks is a strong plus. Electrical & Computer Engineering — analog/mixed-signal IC design, power electronics, RF/microwave, digital system design, FPGA/ASIC, embedded systems. Mechanical Engineering — structural/thermal/fluid system design, mechanism design, HVAC, vibration/dynamics, manufacturing process design. Chemical Engineering — reactor design, process design and optimization, separation systems, transport phenomena, combustion and thermochemistry. Control Systems — classical and modern control design, state estimation, nonlinear and robust control, system identification. Materials / Nano — materials selection under constraints, microstructure-property design, thin-film and nanoscale device design. Engineering Physics / Optics — optical system design, photonic device design, laser systems, wave propagation and interference. Aerospace Engineering — aerodynamic design, propulsion sizing, orbital mechanics, flight dynamics and stability, structural design for aerospace loads. Civil / Structural Engineering — structural member and connection design, foundation design, seismic/wind loading, geotechnical design. Nuclear / Energy — reactor core design, shielding, thermal-hydraulics, renewable energy system sizing, grid-scale storage design. Systems Engineering — system architecture trade studies, requirements decomposition, interface design, multi-subsystem integration. Robotics — kinematic/dynamic design, motion planning, actuator and sensor selection, mechatronic system integration. Required Qualifications: Master’s or PhD in a relevant engineering/applied science field. 3+ years of hands-on engineering design experience, producing validated designs from competing specs (not just analysis). Proficient in at least one open-source simulation tool relevant to the domain. Strong Python (or equivalent) scripting skills. High attention to detail across units, boundary conditions, convergence, and physical realism. Offer Details: Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. description:
A Guaracamp Disponibiliza vagas para pessoas com Deficiência, conforme Art. 93, Lei 8.213/91 e art. 3º e 4º Dec.3.298-99. OBJETIVO DO CARGO Garantir a segurança e saúde dos colaboradores por meio da implementação, fiscalização e orientação de práticas seguras no ambiente de trabalho, identificando e mitigando riscos, promovendo a cultura de prevenção de acidentes e garantindo a conformidade com as normas regulamentadoras. PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES Realizar inspeções diárias em todos os setores da empresa para identificar riscos e condições inseguras. Fiscalizar o uso correto de Equipamentos de Proteção Individual (EPIs) e orientar os funcionários quanto à importância da sua utilização. Inspecionar e manter os sistemas de combate a incêndio (extintores, hidrantes e alarmes) em perfeito funcionamento. Elaborar e atualizar o Programa de Prevenção de Riscos Ambientais (PPRA) e o Perfil Profissiográfico Previdenciário (PPP). Organizar e acompanhar o Programa de Controle Médico de Saúde Ocupacional (PCMSO), orientando sobre exames admissionais, periódicos e demissionais. Manter registros de inspeções, relatórios de acidentes e controle de estoque de EPIs. Preparar e emitir Comunicação de Acidente de Trabalho (CAT). Participar da integração de novos colaboradores, fornecendo orientações de segurança e distribuindo EPIs. Ministrar treinamentos para a CIPA (Comissão Interna de Prevenção de Acidentes) e para a Brigada de Incêndio. Organizar e conduzir a Semana Interna de Prevenção de Acidentes de Trabalho (SIPAT) com palestras e atividades educativas. Acompanhar e investigar acidentes de trabalho, identificar causas e propor soluções preventivas. Participar de perícias e elaborar relatórios detalhados com recomendações para evitar reincidências. Atender às solicitações de EPIs e garantir a reposição do estoque. Avaliar e controlar a exposição dos colaboradores a agentes de risco, incluindo radiação e produtos químicos. Monitorar e garantir o cumprimento das normas regulamentadoras e políticas internas de segurança do trabalho. PRÉ REQUISITOS Curso Técnico em Segurança do Trabalho concluído. Registro ativo no Ministério do Trabalho (MTE). Atuação em ambiente industrial e/ou operações logísticas, com vivências em rotinas operacionais, inspeções de segurança, DDS e investigação de acidentes. Domínio atualizado das NRs com foco em: NR-01 (GRO/PGR);
NR-06/07 (PCMSO/Medicina ocupacional);
NR-11;
NR-12 e NR-35. Conhecimento prático em medicina ocupacional (gestão de ASOs, interface com clínicas e afastamentos). Diferencial: Experiência com auditorias e/ou ISO 45001;
Atuação em ambientes com alto volume operacional. Conhecimento em gestão de EPIs e sistemas de combate a incêndio. Habilitação B. Pacote Office em nível intermediário. title: Qa Engineer
description: About Kestra Kestra is the universal orchestration platform — open source, declarative, and designed to orchestrate data pipelines, IT automation, business workflows, and AI/agentic systems. Trusted by over 10,000 organizations worldwide — including JPMorgan Chase, Bloomberg, FILA, and Crédit Agricole — Kestra orchestrates mission‑critical workloads at scale. The open‑source project has close to 30,000 GitHub stars, hundreds of contributors, and a fast‑growing global community. In March 2026, we closed a $25M Series A led by RTP Global, with participation from Alven, ISAI, and Axeleo – backed by founders from Datadog, dbt Labs, and Hugging Face. The Role We’re looking for a QA Engineer based in Brazil to ensure the quality and reliability of Kestra’s platform across both the open‑source and Enterprise editions. A key part of this role involves working directly with customer support tickets: understanding reported issues, reproducing them in local or staging environments, and verifying fixes before they ship. You’ll be the bridge between what customers experience and what the engineering team delivers. This is a fully remote position. We’re hiring from Brazil for timezone alignment with the broader team. What You’ll Do Review and analyze customer support tickets to understand reported issues, extract reproduction steps, and translate customer‑reported problems into actionable bug reports for the engineering team. Reproduce customer‑reported bugs across different environments and configurations, ensuring the engineering team has the context they need to fix issues efficiently. Design, write, and maintain test plans and test cases covering both the open‑source platform and Enterprise Edition features. Perform manual and exploratory testing for new features and regression testing for existing functionality across each release cycle. Collaborate with engineers to define acceptance criteria, identify edge cases, and validate fixes before release. Contribute to building and improving automated test coverage where applicable. Track and report on quality metrics, test coverage, and recurring issue patterns to help the team prioritize improvements. What We’re Looking For Experience in software QA with a strong foundation in both manual and automated testing methodologies. Ability to read and interpret customer support tickets, often with incomplete information, and systematically reproduce issues. This is central to the role. Familiarity with infrastructure and orchestration concepts: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, or workflow automation tools. You’ll need this context to test effectively. Comfortable working with APIs, reading logs, and navigating distributed systems to trace issues. Experience writing automated tests (for instance, in Java, Python, or TypeScript) and working with test frameworks. Strong written communication in English. You’ll collaborate with a globally distributed team and document issues clearly. Self‑directed and detail‑oriented. You can prioritize across incoming support issues and planned test cycles without heavy oversight. Bonus Points Past experience in a QA role that involved direct interaction with customer‑reported issues or support escalations. Experience with open‑source software or B2B SaaS platforms. Familiarity with orchestration or workflow tools (Airflow, n8n, Terraform, Ansible, or similar). Experience with performance testing or load testing for distributed systems. Knowledge of Java (Kestra’s core is written in Java). What You Get Real ownership in a globally distributed, technical team. Direct exposure to product strategy and company priorities. A product used for mission‑critical workloads — not demos. Competitive compensation, equity, and health insurance. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Analista De Testes Sênior
description:
**You're here because something else has been letting you down.** A trainee program that doesn't actually grow you. A BigCo that promises fast growth and takes 5 years. A consulting firm where all you see is PowerPoint. A startup that's really just a BigCo with beer on Fridays. You want something else. Something you build yourself. We have that.
--- ### Who we are Sofira is an AI-first legaltech. We create AI agents that automate repetitive corporate legal work. The legal industry in Brazil is broken. Large enterprises spend millions on legal claims every year. Our mission is to apply artificial intelligence to solve real pain points, bringing efficiency and scale to complex operations.
--- ### The role: Founder's Associate You will work directly with the CEO to **build and automate processes, define strategy, and stand up new areas of the company from scratch** -- whatever is most important and most urgent in that week. In practice, this means your week-to-week looks wildly different: - One week you're 100% focused on fundraising: researching investors, building the deck, sharpening the strategy.
- The next week you're building an automation bot that sources candidates for our next hire.
- The next week you're standing up our commercial machine from zero: ICP, lead lists, cadences, CRM.
- Sometimes you're doing all three in the same week. The common thread: you figure out what matters most, execute, and ask for help when stuck -- you don't suffer in silence.
--- ### Your first 30 days - **Week 1:** understand everything about Sofira -- product, customers, market, strategy, team. By the end of the week you can explain us in 60 seconds to a stranger.
- **Week 2:** map everything that can be automated. Surface the 5 highest-leverage automations we should build.
- **Week 3:** build the commercial machine from scratch -- ICP, lead sourcing, cadences, CRM, outbound sequences.
- **Week 4:** start generating your own demands. You see what needs to be built next and you propose it. By month 12, you've touched commercial, recruitment, fundraising, operations, and probably 1-2 things we haven't even planned for yet.
--- ### What you get (beyond salary) **Absurdly fast learning.** You'll learn in 12 months what takes 5 years at a corporate. No exaggeration. **Proximity to senior founders.** You'll be in every meeting the CEO is. You'll see product decisions happen. You'll see investor pitches happen. You'll see enterprise contracts being negotiated in real time. **Premium AI tools on us.** ChatGPT Plus, Claude Max, Cursor, Gemini, Perplexity Pro -- whatever helps you move faster, paid by the company.
--- ### Where this role can take you In 18-24 months, depending on how you perform, you'll have 3 open paths: - **Head of an area you built yourself** (most likely Growth, Operations, or Recruiting) -- you'll have natural seniority because you built the playbook - **Chief of Staff** -- you already know how every department works - **Your own company** -- with what you learn here, you'll be ready to start your own thing, if that's your dream.
--- ### Who we're looking for You: - Are in your **last year of college** or **up to 2 years post-graduation** - Are in **Engineering (any), Economics, Business Administration, Accounting, Computer Science, or a similar analytical field** - Come from a **strong university** (Insper, ESPM, FGV, USP, Unicamp, ITA, PUC-RJ/SP, IBMEC, Mackenzie, Federal Universities, or equivalent) - **Built something real during college** -- inside an empresa junior, entrepreneurship league, AIESEC, a side project, a startup, or a student organization. We care less about the title on your resume and more about the output: something that existed because you made it exist. And also: - **You get shit done.** Give you a task with no time, no budget, and no idea how to do it -- you still deliver. You're the person people call when everything's on fire and someone needs to fix it. You squeeze blood from stones.
- **You hate doing by hand what could be automated.** You're allergic to inefficiency. When you catch yourself doing the same task twice, you start plotting how to kill the third time -- with AI, a script, a no-code tool, anything. Manual work that a robot could do makes you twitch.
- **You fall into rabbit holes.** When a topic grabs you, you disappear into it. You've spent an entire weekend learning why airplane windows have a tiny hole, how submarines stay underwater, or something equally random -- just because you couldn't let go. You're self-taught by default. Nobody has to tell you to go learn something.
- **You run multiple things in parallel -- and you like it that way.** Being locked onto one single focus for 6 months would bore you to death. You get energy from context-switching, not tired from it.
- **You want to be great. Yesterday.** Whether that means running your own company one day, being the best at what you do, or leading a team -- you're not willing to wait 5 years to see yourself there. You feel the urgency.
- **You're tech and AI first.** You didn't major in Computer Science, but you speak tech fluently. You prompt well. You read docs. You're comfortable with tools, APIs, and automations even if you don't build them from scratch. If something is possible with code or AI, you know it's possible -- and you'll figure out how. You've probably already turned down a\ "stable\" and predictable offer because you know it's not for you.
--- ### The honest deal We work a lot. This is not a 9-to-5 job. We're building something from zero on top of a R$140 billion market that hasn't seen real innovation in 20 years. That takes everything we have. In return we give: - **Competitive PJ salary.** - **Real ownership of what we build.** We dream big, and we want everyone who builds it alongside us to come along for the ride. You'll own a real piece of the company -- yours to earn as you grow with us.
--- ### This is NOT for you if - You need someone to tell you exactly what to do every day - You prefer stable, predictable environments with well-defined processes - You want to be a specialist in one thing - You feel uncomfortable when you don't know something yet - You want an impressive title more than real impact - You don't tolerate working on multiple fronts at the same time - You expect promotions based on tenure If you read this far and felt uncomfortable with any of these points -- respect the discomfort. Don't apply.
--- ### How to apply Apply and send me (Priscila Holanda) a DM answering this one question: **\ "Tell me about the time you most successfully hacked some (non-computer) system to your advantage.\ "** Bespecific. We want theactual story.

description: 5 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. NICE TO HAVES Professional-level AWS Certification. Experience working with GitLab and Artifactory. Experience with log aggregation and monitoring solutions (Grafana, CloudWatch). Familiarity with APM tools and infrastructure monitoring solutions. Experience driving DevSecOps practices across teams. Strong interest in learning new technologies and driving automation. title: Asb - Auxiliar De Saúde Bucal
description:
SORRISOS ODONTOLOGIA Campo Grande, Rio de Janeiro - Presencial ⚠️ REQUISITOS ELIMINATÓRIOS — LEIA ANTES DE SE CANDIDATAR ⚠️ Residência obrigatória a no máximo 8 km da clínica (Campo Grande, Bangu, Santa Cruz, Guaratiba ou Sepetiba) Certificado de ASB com CRO ativo - Disponibilidade para início imediato QUEM SOMOS Na Sorrisos Odontologia, há mais de 14 anos nossa paixão é transformar vidas através de uma odontologia de excelência, ética, humana e responsável. Nossa missão é ser referência em saúde bucal, proporcionando uma experiência única e de alta qualidade para cada paciente. Nossos valores guiam cada passo: acolhemos as pessoas com honestidade, comprometimento, dedicação e foco na qualidade. Se você busca um ambiente que preza por organização, processos eficientes, modernidade e um cuidado humanizado, você está no lugar certo! A OPORTUNIDADE Procuramos uma Auxiliar de Saúde Bucal (ASB) que seja o braço direito dos nossos cirurgiões-dentistas e a alma da organização no nosso dia a dia. Você será fundamental para garantir o fluxo impecável dos atendimentos, a excelência nos processos de biossegurança e esterilização, e uma organização primorosa em cada detalhe. PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES Biossegurança e Esterilização - Processo completo de lavagem, secagem, selagem e esterilização de instrumentais e canetas, seguindo rigorosamente o POP de Esterilização e as normas da ANVISA.
- Realização semanal de testes biológicos e químicos na autoclave, com registro e controle precisos.
- Manutenção quinzenal da autoclave (limpeza e reposição de água) e semanal do compressor. Organização e Manutenção - Preparo e organização dos consultórios, bancadas, gavetas e armários para cada atendimento, garantindo a prontidão 100% dos atendimentos.
- Limpeza e organização constante das salas de atendimento, esterilização e laboratório de prótese. Gestão de Materiais e Estoque - Controle rigoroso de entrada e saída de materiais, anotações e baixas precisas no estoque.
- Processo completo de compras quinzenal: anotação de necessidades, cotação com no mínimo 4 dentais, pedido, conferência (validade, quantidade, valor) e lançamento no sistema Odontoway.
- Compras de materiais estratégicos como implantes, osso e membrana. Suporte Clínico e Assistência - Auxílio direto aos cirurgiões-dentistas em todos os procedimentos (clínicos e cirúrgicos), com agilidade e proatividade.
- Limpezas pós-cirúrgicas específicas (borracha de soro, rede de sugador) e confecção de placas de clareamento.
- Preenchimento de comunicação interna e criação de requisições no sistema. Gestão de Laboratório e Prótese - Organizar trabalhos para envio, criar requisições e entrar em contato com o laboratório para coletas.
- Verificar o retorno dos trabalhos, lançar no sistema (valor, data, conformidade) e atualizar o status no sistema de gestão.
- Cobrar trabalhos com mais de 7 dias em aberto junto ao laboratório. O PERFIL QUE BUSCAMOS - Organização e Meticulosidade: Perfil sistemático, detalhista e orientado a processos. Para você, cada item tem seu lugar e cada tarefa é executada com precisão.
- Proatividade e Autonomia: Você não espera ser acionada — antecipa as necessidades, age com iniciativa e resolve situações sem supervisão constante.
- Comprometimento e Responsabilidade: Senso de dever inabalável, dedicação genuína e paixão pela entrega de um serviço de alta qualidade.
- Racionalidade e Resolução de Problemas: Abordagem lógica e prática para desafios do dia a dia, buscando otimizar tempo e recursos.
- Habilidade com Ferramentas Digitais: Facilidade em aprender e operar softwares específicos (Clinicorp) e planilhas.
- Empatia e Colaboração: Contribui para um ambiente acolhedor e harmonioso, tanto para pacientes quanto para a equipe.
- Recepção de Feedback: Abertura e maturidade profissional para receber, valorizar e implementar feedbacks de forma positiva e construtiva. POR QUE SE JUNTAR À SORRISOS? - Propósito Transformador: Impacte vidas entregando saúde bucal, sorrisos e autoestima.
- Remuneração Competitiva: Salário fixo de R$ 1.800,00 + Adicional de Insalubridade.
- Regime CLT: Contratação formal com todos os benefícios garantidos.
- Horário: Segunda a sexta, 09:30h às 19h e sábados quinzenais de 08:00h às 14:00h.
- Ambiente de Excelência: Clínica moderna, organizada e que investe em tecnologia (inclusive IA para otimização de processos).
- Cultura de Valorização: Seu comprometimento, proatividade e atenção aos detalhes são reconhecidos e valorizados.
- Desenvolvimento Contínuo: Ambiente dinâmico de alta performance com oportunidades reais de crescimento. COMO SE CANDIDATAR Envie seu currículo para com o assunto: “VAGA ASB — (SEU BAIRRO)” Exemplo: “VAGA ASB — CAMPO GRANDE” ⚠️ IMPORTANTE: Currículos sem informação do bairro ou de candidatas que não residam nas áreas informadas não serão avaliados. Se você busca uma oportunidade onde sua proatividade, organização e comprometimento farão a diferença na transformação de sorrisos e vidas, queremos conhecer você! #ASB #AuxiliarDeSaúdeBucal #Odontologia #VagaDeEmprego #CampoGrandeRJ #SorrisosOdontologia #VagasRJ
